name: Mimura Sumire
source: The organizer of this "Sex Royale" game who invited Yuma. Known as the "Queen of Good Fortune" for having great luck always follow her. Though she didn't understand the purpose of the "Sex Royale" when she signed up she takes her duty seriously. She follows the events going on the island in order to award points either to Yuma or the Female Team. She encourages Yuma to bring out his sadistic side and will reward him with sex at the end of the day.
